This matches the closed list in staged-task-contract.md lines 7-30 one-for-one (instructions/<note>.md 'one or more' -> 3 notes; solution/app/** golden with entry app/server.js). Every required file is present and non-empty (smallest: solve.sh 81 B, scoring.toml 121 B, .dockerignore 37 B; app_context.md 2020 B, which test.sh line 198 reads for {app_context}; tools/score.py and restart_mcp.py present at tests/tools/, invoked by test.sh lines 217/227). Must-be-absent items (contract line 32) are all absent: no tests/reward.toml, no extra tests/ entry, no NOTES.md/SOLUTION.md/.env, no zips, no QC spreadsheets, no saved trial runs/logs, no node_modules (deps are installed globally in environment/Dockerfile via npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1), no *.db/*.db-wal, no __pycache__, no editor/OS junk (.DS_Store, *.swp, *~, *.bak, *.orig), no coverage.json. Live projects/kittle-matter-chat has an identical tree and identical sha256 for every file vs .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/task, so the freeze did not hide any stray live file. Note (not a blocker): solution/app/seed/seed_data.json is a byte-identical copy (sha256 f69616e2...be36) of environment/assets/seed_data.json. It is within solution/app/** and is functional, not residue: server.js line 29 resolves the seed from SEED_PATH, then app/seed/seed_data.json, then /assets/seed_data.json, and solve.sh copies app/ to /app. A stray-file checker may flag a task-specific seed_data.json; per quality-checks.md line 203 and workbook Internal Quality Checks E51 this is a known false positive reported as Note. Limitation: the private check-no-stray-files.py / check-required-files.py executables were not run; this is a manual tree diff against the published closed list, not a portal checker result. No runtime measurement is required for this structural row.
counterexample: Tried: a broken package that could pass (e.g. leftover node_modules, app.db/app.db-wal from a golden run, tests/reward.toml, a .zip or QC xlsx, __pycache__ under tests/tools) -> none present in frozen or live tree. Conforming alternative that could fail: the duplicated seed under solution/app/seed could be flagged by a strict stray-file checker; it is allowed by solution/app/** and is the documented known false positive, so recorded as Note only.
suggested_fix: None required. Optional: if the portal checker flags solution/app/seed/seed_data.json, either keep it (known false positive) or delete it, since server.js already falls back to /assets/seed_data.json (line 29); deleting it would need a fresh candidate and re-QC.
